parole.testo: From Old Church Slavonic мантиꙗ (mantija), from Latin mantum.

parole.significato: beginning of fasting; particularly Месопустна неделя (equivalent to Catholic “Quinquagesima”)
parole.testo: Compound of месо (meso, “meat”) + -о- (-o-) + пуст (pust, “empty, devoid”), inherited from Old Church Slavonic мѧсопоустъ (męsopustŭ). Synchronically, probably a calque of Latin carnisprivium.
Inherited from Old Church Slavonic падежь (padežĭ, “case”), a calque of Latin cāsus. By surface analysis, па́дам (pádam, “to fall”) + -еж (-ež), from Proto-Slavic *padežь.

parole.significato: open exterior platform at the roof of buildings used for rest and recreation (sort of roof terrace)
parole.testo: Semantic specialization of Old Church Slavonic полата (polata, “palace”), of Latin origin. Diachronic doublet of later пала́т (palát).
